events.title: Rent Is Theft: Rally at City Hall
events.blurb: DONE ASKING NICELY. Rent went up again and the council's 'studying it.' Bring signs, bring your neighbors, bring the noise. Meet at the steps — we march at 6.

events.title: New Member Orientation
events.blurb: Curious how the sausage of solidarity gets made? Folding chairs, bad coffee, actual plans. No experience needed — just a pulse and a grudge against your boss.

events.title: Oak Park Free Fridge — Restock Run
events.blurb: The fridge doesn't means-test and neither do we. TAKE WHAT YOU NEED, LEAVE WHAT YOU CAN. Noon restock — hands welcome, questions never asked.

events.title: BENEFIT SHOW: 4 Bands, 0 Cops
events.blurb: Sliding scale at the door — NOBODY TURNED AWAY FOR LACK OF FUNDS. All proceeds to the bail fund. Loud, sweaty, ours.

events.title: Marx for People Who Fell Asleep in Econ
events.blurb: No prereqs, no jargon, no gatekeeping. We read the boring parts so you don't have to. Snacks provided, hot takes encouraged.

events.title: Building-by-Building: Tenant Mapping Night
events.blurb: Your landlord has a group chat. NOW YOU DO TOO. We're mapping the slumlords one building at a time. Bring your lease and your rage.

events.title: Know Your Rights: ICE at the Door
events.blurb: Know your rights BEFORE you need them. Free red cards, the script for the door, and what to do if they show up. Bilingual, childcare on site.

events.title: Del Paso Community Dinner + Supply Drive
events.blurb: Hot food, no strings, no forms. Drop socks/hygiene/anything useful. We feed the block because the state won't.

events.title: Stop the Sweeps — Emergency Response
events.blurb: THEY'RE CLEARING THE CAMP AT DAWN. Legal observers, witnesses, and bodies needed. Show up, film, protect neighbors. Solidarity not sweeps.

events.title: Zine Fair + Screenprint Table
events.blurb: Trade zines, pull a print, learn to make your own propaganda. Bring paper, leave with a movement. Kids and dogs welcome.

events.title: Weekly Chapter Meeting
events.blurb: Committees, campaigns, and what we're actually doing this month. Newcomers get 5 minutes of fame and a buddy. Hybrid — pull up in person or online.

events.title: Renters' Assembly: Citywide
events.blurb: Every building, every hood, one room. Share what your landlord's pulling and plot the response together. ORGANIZED TENANTS DON'T LOSE ALONE.

events.title: Copwatch Training
events.blurb: How to film, where to stand, what the law actually says. Cameras up, rights intact. Bring a charged phone.

events.title: Community Fridge Deep Clean
events.blurb: Gloves, bleach, good playlist. Keeping the fridge alive is the work. An hour of scrubbing = a week of full shelves.

events.title: Palestine Solidarity March
events.blurb: March from the plaza. Signs provided, medics on hand, marshals in vests. Loud, disciplined, unmissable.

events.title: Skill Share: Fix-It Café
events.blurb: Bring a broken thing, leave with a fixed thing + the know-how. Bikes, clothes, small electronics. Repair is resistance to the landfill.
